resources.string: Find NZBs and play them directly with your providers. Credentials stay on this device, in this profile.
Enter the indexer URL; the API path (usually /api) is added to it. Supports Newznab and compatible Prowlarr or NZBHydra endpoints.
Add and enable at least one provider and one indexer to search.
Remove this source and its saved credentials from this profile?
Exclude CAM, telesync and screener releases
Exclude full Blu-ray and DVD discs
Hide whole disc releases. A Blu-ray disc plays from its feature clip; a DVD disc does not play. Remuxes of a disc always show.
Check the name, host, port (1–65535), credentials and connections (1–4096).
Enter a name, a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL and an API path such as /api.
Could not connect. Check the API URL, key and indexer limits.
Providers with the same priority share traffic. Lower priorities are only used for articles the higher ones are missing.

Priority orders your indexers. It decides which copy of a repeated release is kept when Hide repeated releases is on, and which indexers are searched first when Search lower priorities only as fallback is on.
Search lower priorities only as fallback
Off: every indexer is searched. On: lower-priority indexers are only searched when the higher ones find nothing, which saves API hits.
Show the release name of each result above its size, age and indexer.
Show a release found by several indexers once, from the indexer with the highest priority.
Could not connect. Check the host, port and TLS setting.
Secure connection failed. Check the TLS setting and port (usually 563 with TLS, 119 without).
Sign-in failed. Check the username and password.
The provider refused the connection. It may have reached its connection limit, or the account may be inactive.
This is a local network address. Enable Allow self-hosted servers to use it.
Last request failed: API key rejected
Last request failed: could not reach the indexer
Type server addresses, passwords and API keys on your phone instead of the remote.
Scan this QR code with a phone on the same network to add or edit Usenet providers and indexers.
Choose a source or sorting profile, then Save to apply your changes on the TV. Saved passwords and API keys are never shown here: leave them blank to keep them.
Saved. Leave blank to keep it.
This link is no longer valid. Scan the QR code on the TV again.
Enter the password or API key again: a saved one is only used for the server it was saved for.
The TV could not save this. Keep its Usenet settings open, on the same profile, and try again.
Could not load or save Usenet sources. Check device storage and try again.
How Nuvio names itself to indexers, for searches and NZB downloads. Change it only if an indexer asks for a different one.
Use plain text on one line, up to 256 characters.
Show results as each indexer answers
Off: the list appears once every indexer answered, or after 5 seconds if one is slow, and fills in from there. On: it grows and reorders as each indexer answers.

Releases labelled AVAILABLE played recently with your providers, here or in another episode of the same pack. On: they are listed first whatever the sort, and fallback reaches them first. Off: they keep their place.
Sorting, quality, size and age filters
Fallback, missing articles, startup and connections
Timings from the last Usenet startup
